description: We are Johan and Reyaan, two 8th-standard students from Navdeep Public School, Kollam, Kerala. We are interested in space, science, and technology. We are taking part in the NASA Space Apps Challenge to learn new things, explore space-related problems, and create a useful solution using NASA’s data. We hope to use our creativity and ideas to make something exciting and meaningful.
summary:
Lunar Cadets — J&R AstroLabs

Lunar Cadets is an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It takes students through astronaut selection, training, lunar landing, and lunar outpost management.

Players manage essential resources, maintain life-support systems, explore the Moon using rovers, collect scientific samples, and overcome mission challenges. Astra AI, our intelligent guidance assistant, helps players understand objectives and complete missions.

Our project transforms complex space-mission concepts into an engaging learning experience, encouraging students to explore space science, develop problem-solving skills, and understand the challenges of living and working on the Moon.
details:
1. What does your project do or how does it work?

Lunar Cadets is an interactive astronaut mission simulator. Players experience astronaut selection, training, lunar landing, and lunar outpost management while completing tasks, managing resources, exploring with rovers, and handling mission challenges.

2. What benefits does it have?

It makes space science enjoyable and easier to understand. Students develop problem-solving, critical-thinking, decision-making, and resource-management skills through interactive gameplay.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

Our goal is to inspire young students to explore space science and understand the challenges of living and working on the Moon, encouraging future scientists, engineers, and astronauts.

4. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

We used Github for development tools to build our browser-based application and deployed the code using Vercel. The project uses web development technologies such as CSS and TypeScript.

5. How is your project creative?

Lunar Cadets combines astronaut selection, training, lunar landing, rover exploration, outpost management, and AI-powered guidance into one interactive experience instead of teaching space science through ordinary lessons.

6. What factors did your team consider?

We considered educational value, scientific understanding, user-friendliness for younger students, realistic mission challenges, resource limitations, accessibility, and player engagement.

Team: J&R AstroLabs — Johan and Reyaan.
